%% A chat system: clients, the edge, realtime servers, storage and async fan-out.
%% No direction on purpose: Recollect picks the one that shows bigger in a doc.
flowchart
  web([Web app])@{ kind: client }
  mobile([Mobile app])@{ kind: mobile }
  web & mobile -->|HTTPS| cdn[CDN]@{ kind: cdn }
  web & mobile -->|WebSocket| lb[Load balancer]@{ kind: lb }
  subgraph edge [Edge]
    gw[API gateway]@{ kind: gateway }
    auth[Auth service]@{ kind: auth }
  end
  lb --> gw
  gw -->|verify token| auth
  subgraph core [Chat core]
    subgraph realtime [Realtime]:::blue
      ws1[WS server 1]@{ kind: service }
      ws2[WS server 2]@{ kind: service }
    end
    chat[Chat service]@{ kind: service }
    presence[Presence service]@{ kind: service }
  end
  gw --> ws1 & ws2
  ws1 & ws2 -->|send| chat
  ws1 & ws2 -.->|heartbeat| presence
  chat -->|write| msgs[(Messages DB)]@{ kind: database }:::blue
  presence -->|TTL keys| redis[(Redis)]@{ kind: cache }:::red
  chat -.->|message.sent| bus[[Event bus]]@{ kind: stream }:::yellow
  subgraph async [Async workers]
    fanout[Fan-out worker]@{ kind: worker }
    push[Push sender]@{ kind: notify }
    search[Search indexer]@{ kind: search }
  end
  bus -.-> fanout & push & search
  fanout -->|deliver| ws1 & ws2
  push -->|APNs / FCM| ext[Push providers]@{ kind: external }:::gray
  search --> idx[(Search index)]@{ kind: search }
  note for msgs: Partitioned by conversation id
  note for bus: At-least-once: consumers are idempotent
